version.changelog: Fixed: use so.douyin.com instead of www.douyin.com/search for login-free search

llm.summary: This instruction-only skill coherently searches public Douyin pages, with no evidence of credential use, persistence, local data access, or hidden execution.

dimensions.detail: Purpose and behavior align: it searches Douyin and optionally analyzes short-form scripts. The noteworthy part is that user search terms are sent to Douyin or a web search provider.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The main instructions prefer so.douyin.com, but examples mention www.douyin.com/search, which the skill itself says can trigger login/captcha friction.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install script or code, but package metadata is inconsistent across the registry and included files.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Browser and web_search use is proportionate for a public search skill, and there is no evidence of local file, credential, or privileged system access.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background behavior, account mutation, credential storage, or elevated privileges are shown in the artifacts.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This appears safe to use for ordinary Douyin searches and script feedback. Be aware that your search terms may be sent to Douyin or a web search engine, use the so.douyin.com search path, and note that the package metadata is inconsistent.

evidence.explanation: The skill depends on browser automation and web search to retrieve public Douyin results, which is expected for its stated purpose but means search terms leave the local agent context.
evidence.snippet: Use the browser tool to open `so.douyin.com` ... If the browser tool is unavailable, use `web_search`

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Use the skill for searches you are comfortable sending to public web services; avoid sensitive personal or confidential query terms.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: Douyin or a search provider may receive the keywords the user asks the agent to search.

evidence.explanation: This example conflicts with SKILL.md, which says `www.douyin.com/search/` requires login/captcha and instructs use of `so.douyin.com` instead. The conflict appears operational rather than malicious.
evidence.snippet: Opens `https://www.douyin.com/search/海鲜视频` via browser tool

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Prefer the documented `so.douyin.com/s?keyword=` flow and do not provide Douyin credentials unless you intentionally choose to log in outside this skill.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: The agent might occasionally open a login-gated Douyin page if it follows the example instead of the main instructions.

evidence.explanation: These embedded metadata values differ from the supplied registry metadata for owner, slug, and version. Because the skill is instruction-only and has no install code, this is a provenance/packaging note rather than evidence of unsafe behavior.

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Install only if you trust the registry entry, and prefer a package with consistent owner, slug, and version metadata.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: The package identity is somewhat inconsistent, which can make provenance harder to verify.

abnormal_behavior_control.summary: Browser/web-search use and minor metadata or documentation inconsistencies are present, but they are purpose-aligned and not hidden.

permission_boundary.summary: No credentials, account privileges, tokens, or delegated authority are requested or shown.

sensitive_data_protection.summary: No persistent memory, local private data indexing, inter-agent data sharing, or sensitive storage behavior is shown.
